title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from France
objectives: Link grapes to their French homes

steps.prompt: Match each region to its main grape.
steps.explanation: French labels name the place; knowing the grapes unlocks them.

steps.prompt: Which French region usually names the grape on the label?
steps.explanation: Alsace names the variety, like Germany.

steps.prompt: Bordeaux's Left Bank favours Cabernet Sauvignon on gravel soils.
steps.explanation: Yes. Gravel drains and stores heat, helping a late-ripening grape.

steps.prompt: Order these Loire areas from the Atlantic inland.
steps.explanation: The Loire flows west to the Atlantic; the Central Vineyards are furthest upstream.

steps.title: What you learned
points: AOC rules tie wine to place, with nested levels
The Loire, Alsace and the Rhône each have their own grapes
The south has shifted from bulk to quality, with Provence leading rosé
